name: V3B_final
description: Production mask. Pillar diameter 0.50 mm everywhere - the smallest the shop can make. Zone 1 carries the CERN bulk layout as the reference: 0.50 mm pillars on the same 2.00 x 2.00 mm grid, at the same coordinates as CERN's P2_Mask2. Zones 2-5 are hexagonal with the least dense support in the centre: 2.20 % (zone 2), 0.75 % (zone 3, centre), 1.10 % (zone 4), 1.60 % (zone 5) dead area. A continuous 1.00 mm resist wall runs along each zone boundary so the zones are physically separated; as a consequence only zone 1 is vented by the evacuation channel during lamination.

zone_walls.note: continuous by request (2026-09-15): zones 2-5 have no path to the evacuation channel during lamination

zones.reference: CERN bulk 3717-A (P2_Mask2): 0.50 mm on a 2.00 x 2.00 mm grid, identical coordinates; deliberately over the 3 % budget
